verdict.rationale: Reclaim documents Scheduling Links with "smart meeting controls" and its own Buffer Time feature, which adds decompression time after meetings and travel time before and after located events. That covers only the buffer element, and the docs never tie those buffers to booking-link availability. Missing for 10: minimum-notice settings for booking links, daily booking caps, date-range booking windows, explicit before/after buffers configured per scheduling link, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, I can protect my calendar with buffers before and after meetings, minimum notice, daily booking caps, and date-range windows

citations.quote: Share your availability using smart meeting controls.
Decompression Time: auto-add time after meetings to take a break.
Travel Time: auto-add time before and after events with a location.
Scheduling Links enable you to send links to you and your team's availability, allowing others to book time across one, or many, calendars.
